identity.affine_arithmetic: Arb encloses c0+exact_delta*v and alpha0+exact_delta*w before all fixed base weights
identity.parameter_arithmetic: First form complete exact center and direction scalar polynomials; then add the single p in [-eta,eta]. No independent raw-control parameter intervals are introduced.
identity.exact_delta_fraction_scope: The exact_delta_fraction field names the center only; all bounds cover the separately stated whole exact_parameter_interval.

exact_local_compression: diag(Qcos,Qcos)^* T_j diag(Qcos,Qcos), with Qcos columns e0 and (ek+e-k)/sqrt(2); no newly chosen floating local centers.
local_compression_error_rule: The actual angular invariant transfer is compressed by isometries, so its complete local error is no greater than the already paid original error.
exact_DN_formula: scale*C*A^-1, A=Pww, C=Ppw; the waist-even initial flux is exactly zero.
normalized_boundary_coordinates: (w_left,w_right)=(Qcos*v,Qcos*v)/sqrt(2); the two outward fluxes have the same sign. This normalization gives scale*C*A^-1 without an extra factor two.
two_regular_ports_not_deleted: The paired complete-cap regular coordinate is still required when assembling the desired finite low block.

arrays.definition: core_DN_even_waist is an exact dyadic Hermitian center with the complete radius stated above. The positive transfer is a diagnostic selected center with its separate selection fee.

old_floating_core_even_comparison.old_scope: Only a previously saved floating diagnostic.

scope: All original accepted positive leaves and the entire same eta interval are required and checked.
Actual angular and waist symmetry determine the complete desired finite problem, retaining the angular mean.
No full finite P inverse, reflected whole transfer or odd-waist Dirichlet inverse is required.
The six-dimensional complete low block still needs the true cap, uniform quarter-cut multipliers and full symmetric high feedback.
No full infinite-core DN inverse is assumed or certified.
